home.title: Melrose Area Historical Society — Museum & Heritage Center
home.description: Museum, research center and historical society preserving the history and heritage of Melrose, Minnesota and the School District 740 communities.

visit.title: Visit the Museum
visit.description: Hours, admission, directions, what to see and the museum store at the Melrose Area Museum, housed in the former Melrose convent near St. Mary's Church.
visit.lede: Everything you need to plan your trip — and a peek at what’s inside.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Stories and artifacts from the Melrose Area Museum: Native Americans, the hospital, convents, milliners, Capt. James Gallagher, Francis Lent, the Melrose Theater and the Lindberghs.
collections.lede: More than 2,000 indexed items and the stories behind them.

research.title: Research Center
research.description: Search family histories, oral history tapes, video histories, newspaper articles, obituaries and photographs at the Melrose Area Museum research center.
research.lede: Trace your family and the history of the Melrose area.

involved.title: Get Involved
involved.description: Join the Melrose Area Historical Society or volunteer at the Melrose Area Museum.
involved.lede: Join the Society or lend a hand at the museum.

about.title: About the Society
about.description: The mission, history, building and board of the Melrose Area Historical Society, an affiliate of the Stearns County Historical Society.
about.lede: Preserving the history and heritage of the Melrose area since 1987.
